missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Волк' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'живёт'. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'в лесу' locates it.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Волка' takes the genitive-shaped accusative because 'волк' is animate masculine, serving as the object of 'увидели'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Волка' takes the genitive after 'нет ни одного', stressing that not a single wolf is present.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Волку' is in the dative after 'к', showing approach toward the wolf. 'Боятся' explains the sheep's reluctance.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Волком' is in the instrumental after 'с', marking the wolf as the opponent. 'Дралась' names the fight.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Волке' takes the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of the tale. 'Читали' names the activity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Волки' is the nominative plural subject of 'бегали'. 'Серые' agrees in the plural, and 'по полю' locates them.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Волков' takes the genitive plural after 'вой', expressing whose howling it is. 'Ночью' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of an animate noun. 'Волков' takes the genitive-shaped accusative plural because wolves are animate, as the object of 'кормлю'. 'Зимой' sets the season.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in motion. 'Волк' is the nominative subject of 'бежал'. 'Быстро' adds speed, and 'по снегу' describes the path.
